meta.seo_title: Native Country Names & ISO Codes - Free Download (Excel/CSV/PDF)
meta.seo_description: Download native names, official names, and ISO codes for 195 countries. Free in Excel, CSV, PDF. Ideal for dev, analysis, and education.
meta.title: Global Native Country Names & ISO Codes Dataset
meta.description: Explore 195 independent countries with this dataset, featuring their English and native common/official names, native languages (ISO 639-3), and ISO Alpha-2/Alpha-3 codes.
key_takeaways: Access native and official names for 195 countries worldwide.
Explore associated native languages and standard ISO Alpha-2/Alpha-3 codes.
Download comprehensive country data for linguistic and geographic analysis.
Leverage accurate, up-to-date country identification information.
use_cases: Import the **CSV** file into your SQL database or Python script to build applications requiring country-specific native naming conventions.
Use the **Excel** file to filter and sort countries by native language, or perform VLOOKUP for linguistic analysis and reporting.
Print the **PDF** version for quick offline reference in classrooms, during presentations, or for educational material development.
Leverage this data to enhance internationalization (i18n) efforts in software, ensuring correct country name display for global users.
